command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=60d47ebffe951a3087a01251ab93388536b1e3e3
REMOTE=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}')
printf 'EXPECTED=%s\nREMOTE_MAIN=%s\n' "$EXPECTED" "$REMOTE"
if [ "$REMOTE" != "$EXPECTED" ]; then echo 'REFUSE_STALE_OMEGA_INSTALL: main advanced; no runtime bytes changed'; exit 42; fi
ROOT=/tmp/omega-final-install-60d47
if [ ! -d "$ROOT/repo/.git" ]; then mkdir -p "$ROOT"; gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/frankenstein "$ROOT/repo" -- --quiet; fi
cd "$ROOT/repo"
git fetch -q origin
git checkout -q --detach "$EXPECTED"
python3 tests/test_voice777_installer_convergence.py
bash scripts/install_voice_777_omega.sh
for f in omega_arm_bus.py omega_organ_activity.py voice777_local_audio_arm.py voice777_omni_presence.py voice777_pocket_renderer.py voice_full_runtime.py frank_terminal.py voice_777_runtime.py voice_host_777_live_client.py frank_terminal_777.py; do cmp -s "scripts/$f" "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/$f"; printf 'MATCH %s\n' "$f"; done
